name: chat-bubbles
description: Messenger-style chat for Claude Code: your prompts on the right in a rival color, Claude on the left, only running or failing tools stand out. 441 themes. (Vendored from github.com/angeldelbiondo/claude-chat-bubbles @ 5597448, MIT. Modified for my-claude-mods: the footer keeps the row beneath, so plan-progress's button stays; other mods' panes get the backdrop without side padding; an empty tool result gets no stripe; the spinner shimmers from the main turn's start to its end.)
